Performers
Eric Xi Xin Liang (piano) Documented

Commons credits Eric Xi Xin Liang for performance and recording; the corresponding IMSLP entry explicitly identifies piano. No viola player is credited. The optional or historically ambiguous viola notation does not establish that a viola is heard here, so no additional performer or ensemble timeline is supplied.

[1] [2]
Work version
Unknown Unknown

Commons does not identify the performing edition. IMSLP separately lists Liang’s annotated score based on the 1947 edition, but does not establish that it was used for this recording. No choice between the first edition and revised text is asserted. The listening map gives approximate passages, not edition-specific bar alignment.

[1] [2] [3]
Recorded
2024 Documented

The source’s Summary gives 2024 for this performance/recording. The file was uploaded on 14 July 2024; that is not an established session day. No common session with the other movements is assumed.

Place
Unknown Unknown

Neither consulted recording entry identifies a venue, city, piano or live-versus-studio setting.

Label
Unknown Unknown

No record label is identified. IMSLP gives ‘Eric Xi Xin Liang, 2024’ as publisher information for the audio; this documents a publisher credit, not a named commercial label. Neither entry provides a sleeve or label scan.

Catalogue
Unknown Unknown

No carrier catalogue number is supplied. IMSLP’s file index 922791 is a repository identifier, not a record catalogue number.

Matrix, take, sides
Unknown Unknown

No matrix, take or side information is supplied. The uploaded FLAC format alone does not establish the original session medium or the number of takes.

Transfer
Eric Xi Xin Liang — performance and recording Documented

The source explicitly credits Liang as the recording’s creator. Uploader D. Benjamin Miller is not automatically a transfer or mastering engineer; no separate engineer is named.

[1]
Transfer date
Unknown Unknown

No transfer or mastering date is supplied. The July 2024 upload and February 2026 Wikimedia transcode dates are not substituted for it.

[1]
Processing
Unknown Unknown

No editing, mastering, noise reduction, restoration or source-transfer procedure is documented. The MP3 access encoding is described separately; it does not identify the original recording chain.

[1] [2]
Composition rights
Public domain as asserted in Commons’ separate musical-composition notice Documented

The composition notice cites Ives’s death in 1954 and publication before 1931; it is separate from the recording licence. The first score was printed in 1920 and circulated in January 1921. The performing edition is unknown: this notice does not independently clear later revisions or editorial additions, and IMSLP marks the revised 1947 score non-public-domain in the United States.

[1] [3] [2]
Recording rights
Rule 1 — explicit sound-recording licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International Documented

The opened Commons page explicitly places CC BY 4.0 under ‘Recording’, naming Liang as performer/recording creator. Its separate public-domain composition notice is not used to license the recording. The matching IMSLP recording entry also states CC BY 4.0. Attribution and a licence link are required; this is not a claim that the 2024 sound recording is public domain.
